tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Latest offer or counter from each demo seller on your thread. Needs your buyer_token. Not affiliated with any store, brand or platform. HaggleBoard is not a party to any sale.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Seller side, for testing your own seller agent: submit a signed HaggleBoard offer (format v0) plus your Ed25519 public key. You see the need through a disclosure filter and only your own messages. Not affiliated with any store, brand or platform. HaggleBoard is not a party to any sale.

tools.description: Counter a demo seller's latest price. Must respect the mandate's walk_away. The seller replies at once. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_offers, get_deal_token, update_mandate · Private data: post_need, get_deal_token · Public sink: post_need, make_offer · Destructive: make_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_offers, get_deal_token, update_mandate · Private data: post_need, get_deal_token · Public sink: post_need, make_offer · Destructive: make_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
